newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Servgro 2nd phase unbundling details in H2.
newsitem.headline: Servgro 2nd phase unbundling details in H2.

text.p: South African industrial group Servgro International Ltd said on Friday that details of the second phase of the group's unbundling were unlikely to be announced before June 30.

The second phase of the split-up of the concern will result in the distribution of Servgro's cash resources and any realisation proceeds of its remaining assets and/or the distribution of shares in its remaining assets. These include Interleisure Ltd, Teljoy Holdings Ltd, Fedics Group (Pty) Ltd and Interpark (Pty) Ltd.
Following the unbundling Servgro may liquidate and delist.
